'''Sherman Extension Gas Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenterprise_duncan_energy_complete_sherman_extension_pipeline_expansion_250309|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Erath County, Texas to Grayson County (Sherman), Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://undergroundinfrastructure.com/magazine/2008/december-2008-vol-63-no-12/newsline/enterprise-to-build-texas-based-supply-laterals|title=undergroundinfrastructure.com|website=undergroundinfrastructure.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenterprise_duncan_energy_complete_sherman_extension_pipeline_expansion_250309|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
===Main Line===
*'''Owner: '''Enterprise Products Partners LP<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenterprise_duncan_energy_complete_sherman_extension_pipeline_expansion_250309|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''950 MMcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenterprise_duncan_energy_complete_sherman_extension_pipeline_expansion_250309|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Oct2025.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''174 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Oct2025.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenterprise_duncan_energy_complete_sherman_extension_pipeline_expansion_250309|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Diameter: '''30, 36 in<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Oct2025.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/newsenterprise_duncan_energy_complete_sherman_extension_pipeline_expansion_250309|title=nsenergybusiness.com|website=nsenergybusiness.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Cost: '''US$522,000,000<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.eia.gov/naturalgas/pipelines/EIA-NaturalGasPipelineProjects_Oct2025.xlsx|title=eia.gov|website=eia.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
